objectives.contour_a: Qualify a verifiable autonomous engineering environment with GitHub-hosted control/execution infrastructure, safe routing, resumable quotas, secret isolation and provenance.
objectives.contour_b: Do not begin until Contour A is deployed and independently accepted.

architecture_invariants: Large tasks may originate from ChatGPT or Jarvis.
ASTRA GOLD A0 decomposes large tasks into a dependency graph and routes subtasks among admitted cloud workers, user-owned MediaHub compute nodes, and qualified local executors.

GitHub Supervisor supplies execution/control-plane capabilities such as queueing, dispatch, monitoring, recovery and evidence collection; it does not replace A0 as the decomposition/routing authority.
User-owned MediaHub are compute resources, not automatically subordinate product-state authorities.
Product State Authority remains distinct from Jarvis and ASTRA GOLD A0.
Issuer/capability, consent, least privilege, data boundaries, quota policy and revocation are mandatory.
Quantization and selective/streamed model loading are distinct mechanisms and may be combined when the chosen model/runtime supports them.

A user MediaHub reserves an explicit, user-visible disk budget at installation for authorized model assets, cache and temporary task data; the exact quota is configurable and must not silently consume unbounded storage.

Only task-required model components should be resident in RAM/VRAM when supported by the selected model architecture/runtime; disk-backed weights or offloading can reduce memory requirements but may reduce throughput.
Model selection must be based on task quality, runtime compatibility, license/terms, disk/RAM/VRAM, bandwidth, latency, energy and quota, not model size alone.
No secrets in prompts, model context, logs, artifacts or repository documents.
Gemini dispatch exclusively uses the approved GitHub Actions controller and its gates; no alternate transport or paid fallback.
